profiles.name: Ernesto Mangaoang
profiles.research_note: Primary Ninth Circuit opinion 186F2d191 located: https://law.justia.com/cases/federal/appellate-courts/F2/186/191/162842/ . Explicit Aug1,1949 arrest and next-day bail; Nov17–28,1949 additional confinement; Director affidavit explicitly Oct22,1950 custody under telegraphic directive followed Oct27 warrant. Narrative incorrectly juxtaposes 1949 release and1950 warrant, so read against original87FSupp932 and contemporary reports before constructing separate custody periods. Existing1949year start cannot be paired with eventual1950release as continuous detention. Secondary Amerasia article reports continued solitary confinement after Oct25court order, highlighting court order not physical release. Original1950 endpoint still requires confirmation. Pending guarded data correction; no live modification this turn. Further primary corroboration: ILWU Dispatcher March16,1951 p8 explicitly says recently released after70days; February2,1951 issue confirms already released and attending Portland union meeting, calls duration three months (rounded). 1951ILWU convention proceedings independently report70days before bail. Sources https://archive.ilwu.org/wp-content/uploads/2015/02/19510316.pdf ; https://archive.ilwu.org/wp-content/uploads/2015/02/19510202.pdf ; https://digicoll.lib.berkeley.edu/record/72103/files/lb001718.pdf . Supports documented70day later spell, but not exact endpoint or treating all1949–1951 detention as continuous. Need model separate custody episodes before updating existing aggregate case. Additional release lead: MichaelMcCann/GeorgeLovell Union by Law scholarly history explicitly gives Jan12,1951 release after83days, conflicting with70days in contemporary ILWU summaries; https://dokumen.pub/union-by-law-filipino-american-labor-activists-rights-radicalism-and-racial-capitalism-9780226680071.html . Jan12 minus Oct22=82elapsed days (83inclusive); do not substitute stated83 as elapsed counter. Seattle historic preservation report independently says83days but not endpoint. Direct Jan5/Jan19,1951 Dispatcher downloads returned403; source-date corroboration remains pending. No date arithmetic used to manufacture release. CustodyPeriods schema inspected: supports discrete start/end intervals, so eventual verified update must exclude bail gaps.
